verdict.rationale: Unstructured says it parses scans into structured data. Its Auto strategy routes each page to Fast, High Res, or VLM partitioning, and an optional generative OCR enrichment uses a VLM to improve the fidelity of text blocks after partitioning. These are first-party claims of a scanned-document OCR path, but none addresses the hard cases in the story. missing for 10: explicit handling of skewed or rotated pages, handling of stamps or overlaid marks, evidence of performance on low-quality or photographed scans, accuracy benchmarks, independent or hands-on corroboration of OCR quality.
